why_not_llm.title: General-purpose AI predicts the next word. AssureProof proves the math.
why_not_llm.sub: ChatGPT and Claude are built to sound plausible, not to guarantee mathematical consistency across a 300-page document stack. When a missed clause or billing overage costs thousands of dollars, probability is not enough.

core_engine.llm: Probabilistic — guesses the most likely text based on patterns.
core_engine.assure: Deterministic — mathematically tests every figure and rule using a Z3 formal logic solver.

math.llm: Often misses subtle discrepancies or loses accuracy as file length grows ("lost in the middle").
math.assure: Z3 checks whether every figure, clause, and citation can all be true at the same time. A contradiction stops export.

traceability.llm: Citations can be vague, paraphrased, or fabricated.
traceability.assure: Every claim is pinned directly to the exact source document, page, and line.

conflict_handling.llm: Quietly smooths over contradictions to give you a polite, confident answer.
conflict_handling.assure: Automatically locks export upon disagreement, forcing a human decision.

audit.llm: No built-in approval gates or cryptographic audit log of who overrode a discrepancy.
audit.assure: Full governance trail recording every flagged conflict, reviewer sign-off, and override.

residency.llm: Prompts and files typically pass through third-party cloud APIs.
residency.assure: Runs 100% inside your AWS account, private GPU, or air-gapped on-prem server.

cta.text: Use LLMs to brainstorm. Use AssureProof before you sign, pay, or file.

government.title: Government Document Checks
government.subtitle: Verify procurement bids and regulatory packets before sign-off.

conflict.label: Live Conflict Example
conflict.source_a: RFP Schedule B, p. 4 — Max Subcontractor Cap: 15%
conflict.finding: Subcontractor allocation exceeds statutory 15% cap by 9.5% ($367,500).
conflict.outcome: Export Locked — Exceeds statutory threshold by 9.5% ($367,500).

insurance.title: Insurance Claims Review
insurance.subtitle: Audit complex claims against policy limits, endorsements, and medical bills.

conflict.label: Live Conflict Example
conflict.source_b: Adjuster Payout Summary, p. 6 — Approved Remediation Payout: $68,400
conflict.finding: Adjuster worksheet approves $68,400 remediation — exceeds $50,000 water damage sub-limit by $18,400.
conflict.outcome: Result: Export Locked — Exceeds endorsement cap by $18,400.

fuel.title: Fuel Retail Bonus Reconciliation
fuel.subtitle: Fuel Delivery Logs are checked against Bonus Rebate Statements. Source pages stay linked. Contradictions appear on the review screen. Export blocked on the review screen. A person or an agent decides. The file can still be downloaded.

conflict.label: Live Conflict Example
conflict.source_a: FY26 Comp Plan, Sec. 3.1 — Accelerator Rate (100%+ Quota): 1.5x
conflict.source_b: Q4 Payroll Sheet, Row 42 — Applied Multiplier: 2.0x (+$31,200)
conflict.finding: Applied multiplier (2.0x) conflicts with plan terms (1.5x cap). Overage: +$31,200.
conflict.outcome: Result: Export Locked — Multiplier conflicts with signed plan terms.

z3.title: Z3 Conflict
z3.body: Export blocked — the two sources cannot both be true. A person or an agent decides, and the file can still be downloaded.
